div.div: حَيْقُطَانٌ , (IDrd, S, K,) and حَيْقَطَانٌ, but the former is the more chaste, (IDrd,) and the latter is mentioned by none but IDrd, (IKh,) and ↓ حَيْقُطٌ , (K,) The [bird called] دُرَّاج [i. e. attagen, francolin, heath-cock, or rail: but see this last Arabic word]: (K:) or the male of the دُرَّاج: (S, K:) but IF says, I do not think it correct: (TA:) fem. حَيْقُطَانَةٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
